info.title: Flixnet API
info.description: API of the Flixnet media server. Used by the web UI and future native apps.

servers.description: The Flixnet server serving this document

post.summary: Sign in with name and password.
Sign out: revokes the token used for this request.

get.summary: Household profiles for the "Who's watching?" picker.

post.summary: Switch this device to another household profile.
post.description:
Issues a new token for the target profile and revokes the current one.
Profiles with a PIN need the PIN; administrators without a PIN need their password.

200.description: Switched; use the new token from now on

403.description: Wrong PIN or password for the target profile

get.summary: Collections with at least one visible member, by name.
A collection with its visible members in release order.

delete.summary: Delete a collection (administrators). Automatic ones return on the next refresh.

patch.summary: Rename or re-describe a manual collection (administrators).

get.summary: Collection artwork (poster or backdrop), resized and cached.
get.description:
Use the signed URLs returned by the collection endpoints; alternatively
authenticate normally.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Expiry of the signature (unix seconds), from URLs returned by the API.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: URL signature, from URLs returned by the API.

401.description: Neither a valid signature nor a valid token

post.summary: Add movies or series to a manual collection (administrators).

delete.summary: Remove a movie or series from a manual collection (administrators).

get.summary: Browse server folders to pick library paths (administrators only).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder to list; empty lists the file system roots (drives on Windows).

404.description: Folder does not exist or is not readable

get.summary: Genres used in the visible libraries.
An artwork image, resized and cached.
get.description: Use the signed URLs returned by item endpoints; alternatively authenticate normally.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Desired width in pixels (snapped up to 92, 185, 342, 500, 780, 1280 or 1920).

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: Expiry of the signature (unix seconds), from URLs returned by the API.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: URL signature, from URLs returned by the API.

401.description: Neither a valid signature nor a valid token

get.summary: All invitations (administrators only).
Is this invitation code still usable?

200.description: Whether the code can be redeemed

post.summary: Redeem an invitation: create the own account and sign in.

get.summary: Browse and search items.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search over titles and descriptions.

get.summary: Jump bar: items per first letter (title order) with the offset to jump to.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search over titles and descriptions.

Collections a movie or series belongs to, each with its visible members
("Teil der Sammlung …" on detail pages).
Search TMDB for candidates matching a movie or series.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search text (defaults to the item's title).

Sources of a movie or episode with a playback decision for the client's device.

404.description: No such item, or nothing playable

put.summary: Mark as watched (series/seasons: all their episodes).

post.summary: Re-read NFO/artwork and provider data for an item and its children.

get.summary: Recent and pending background jobs.

200.description: Running first, then queued, then finished (newest first)

get.summary: Job counts per pool and state.

404.description: No such pending or running job

post.summary: Run a failed or cancelled job again.

get.summary: Libraries the signed-in user may see.

post.summary: Create a library and start its first scan (administrators only).

get.summary: One library.

delete.summary: Delete a library and everything in it from Flixnet (files on disk stay untouched).

patch.summary: Rename a library or change its folders (administrators only).

post.summary: Scan a library for new, changed and removed files (administrators only).

get.summary: A person and their movies/series in the library.
Own playlists and those shared by other profiles.

post.summary: Create a playlist (with `smart_filter`: a smart playlist).

get.summary: A playlist with its items (smart playlists: evaluated now, for the signed-in user).

patch.summary: Rename, share/unshare, or change a smart playlist's filter (owner only).

post.summary:
Add movies and episodes (series and seasons as all their episodes) at the end
(owner only). Items already in the playlist are skipped.

get.summary: Metadata provider settings.

put.summary: Change metadata provider settings. A new TMDB key is checked against TMDB.

parameters.description: User the URL was issued to, from URLs returned by the API.

get.summary: Get server information.
Hardware transcoding: what was detected at startup and what transcodes use.

200.description: Encoders, tone mapping and ffmpeg version

get.summary: Recurring maintenance tasks.

patch.summary: Change a task's interval or switch it on/off.

get.summary: Active transcode sessions (administrators).

delete.summary: Ends a session (the player closed); stops its ffmpeg and removes its files.

get.summary: The fMP4 init segment.
The session's VOD playlist (all segments, so players can seek anywhere).
One media segment (`{n}.m4s`); seeking far ahead restarts the transcode there.
All users (administrators only).

post.summary: Create a user or household profile (administrators only).

get.summary: The signed-in user.
Devices signed in to the own account.

delete.summary: Sign out one of the own devices.

put.summary: Change the own password. Signs out all other devices.
Set or remove the own profile PIN.

delete.summary: Delete a user (administrators only; not yourself).

409.description: Name taken, or the last administrator would be lost

get.summary: A user's library access (administrators only).

put.summary: Set a user's library access (administrators only).

added.description: How many were new (already present ones are skipped).

max_channels.description: Most channels played without downmix (2 when omitted).

score.description: 0–1: how well the candidate fits the item's title and year.

item_count.description: Members the signed-in user may see.

played_count.description: Of those, how many the user has watched.

poster_url.description: Signed poster URL (the collection's own, else a member's), 342 px wide.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB collection id of automatic collections.

max_age_rating.description: Age limit applied to the new account.

note.description: Free text, e.g. who the invitation is for.

valid_days.description: Days until the link expires (1–30, default 7).

paths.description: Absolute folder paths on the server.

password.description: Omit for a profile that cannot sign in remotely (only reachable by switching).

code.description: The secret code; shown once. The web UI link is `/invite/{code}`.

DeviceInfo.description: The client installation that is signing in.

id.description: Stable id generated and stored by the client (e.g. a UUID).

DeviceProfile.description:
What a client can play directly. Web clients build it from `canPlayType` /
`MediaSource.isTypeSupported`; native apps send a fixed one.

containers.description: File containers the client plays as-is (file extensions: `mp4`, `webm`, `mkv`, …).

max_bitrate.description: Upper bound for the total bitrate (bits/s), e.g. for slow connections.

multiple_audio_tracks.description:
Whether the client can switch between audio tracks of one file. Browsers
cannot, so another track than the default one needs a remux.

path.description: The listed folder (`null` for the roots).

decode_error.description: Why GPU decoding does not work.

device.description: Render node used (VA-API, Quick Sync on Linux).

error.description: Why encoding does not work (ffmpeg's last lines).

hw_decode.description: The GPU decodes HEVC Main 10 too.

tonemap.description: How HDR is tone-mapped with this method.

tonemap_error.description: Why GPU tone mapping does not work.

ErrorBody.description: Error body returned by every failing API call.

ItemCardDto.description: Enough to draw a poster card.

child_count.description: Seasons of a series / episodes of a season.

position_ms.description: Resume position in milliseconds (0 = from the start).

poster_url.description: Signed poster URL (episodes: still image), 342 px wide.

offset.description: Offset of the first item with this letter in title order.

LibraryAccess.description: Which libraries a user may see.

unprobed.description: Files whose technical details are still being read.

paths.description: Folder paths on the server (administrators only).

direct_url.description: Signed URL of the original file (supports HTTP range requests).

hls_url.description: HLS playlist of a transcode session, when the plan is not Direct Play.

plan.description: How this source would be played on the requesting device, and why.

has_fanart_api_key.description: Whether a fanart.tv API key is stored.

has_tmdb_api_key.description: Whether a TMDB API key is stored (the key itself is never returned).

credits.description: Everything in the visible libraries this person worked on.

sources.description: Playable versions/parts of the item, main versions first.

audio_stream_index.description: Chosen audio stream (file stream index); default track when omitted.

device_profile.description: What the client can play directly; an empty profile means "transcode everything".

max_bitrate.description: Quality limit chosen by the user (bits/s).

subtitle_stream_index.description: Chosen subtitle stream (file stream index); none when omitted.

is_owner.description: The signed-in user owns (and may edit) the playlist.

item_count.description: Items the signed-in user may see.

poster_urls.description: Up to four signed poster URLs of the first items (for a collage).

shared.description: Visible to every profile of the household (read-only for them).

oneOf.description: The filter of a smart playlist.

entry_id.description: Id of the entry (for removing and reordering); `null` in smart playlists.

item_ids.description: Movies and episodes; series and seasons are added as all their episodes.

entry_ids.description: Entry ids in the new order. Entries not listed keep their relative order after them.

is_current.description: The profile currently signed in on this device.

Reason.description: Why the file cannot simply be played as-is.

job_id.description: Job id, or `null` if a scan of this library is already pending.

SessionDto.description: A newly issued device token plus the signed-in user.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Valid until logout or re-login on this device.

pin.description: 4–8 digits, or `null` to remove the PIN.

setup_required.description: `true` until the first administrator account has been created.

SmartFilterDto.description:
Saved filter of a smart playlist (the fields of `GET /items`). Empty lists and
missing values do not filter.

library_ids.description: Only these libraries (still limited to what the viewer may see).

played.description: Watched (`true`) or unwatched (`false`) by the viewer.

SystemInfo.description: Public server information used by clients to discover and identify the server.

api_version.description: API version that the routes are served under.

os.description: Operating system the server runs on.

Tonemap.description: How HDR is tone-mapped to SDR.

transcoding.description: An ffmpeg process is currently running for this session.

TranscodingInfo.description: What transcodes run on, for the admin diagnostics.

detected.description: Detection has finished (until then transcodes use software).

fallbacks.description:
Hardware runs that failed and were retried with a simpler pipeline since the
server started.

hw_decode.description: The GPU decodes too (where it can decode the source).

probes.description: Every method that was tested, in test order.

tonemap.description: How HDR is tone-mapped to SDR.

Unlock.description: What switching to a profile requires.

fanart_api_key.description: fanart.tv personal API key; `null` removes it.

tmdb_api_key.description: TMDB v3 API key or v4 read access token; `null` removes it.

UpdateUserRequest.description: Every field is optional; `null` clears nullable fields (password, PIN, age limit).

password.description: Setting or clearing the password signs the user out everywhere.

has_password.description: Can sign in with a password (profiles without one are reachable by switching only).

has_pin.description: Profile switching to this user requires a PIN.

is_hidden.description: Hidden users do not appear in the profile picker.

hdr.description: HDR formats shown as HDR (`hdr10`, `hlg`, `dovi`); others are tone-mapped.

codec.description: Output codec (the source codec when copied).

tonemap.description: HDR → SDR tone mapping during the transcode.

api_key.name: api_key
api_key.description: Device token as query parameter, for URLs that cannot carry headers (media, images).
